name: repo-kickoff
description: Start a new repository, locally and as a private GitHub repo, whose setup can be reproduced and checked (pinned dependencies, Python version, a tested pre-commit gate that blocks common API keys and passwords, main before branches), and audit an existing repo: README and requirements against its code, .gitignore, and secrets already committed, and two everyday modes: carrying a task from branch to merged pull request, and diagnosing and undoing git mistakes after the user's OK.
